name: Elixir and Erlang (Hex)
description: Reads Mix's mix.lock (every format since Mix 1.0): every Hex package with its exact version, including transitive ones and packages renamed in mix.exs. Packages are checked against OSV's Hex advisories (GitHub and the Erlang Ecosystem Foundation's CNA).
known_limitations: Git and path dependencies have no released version and are not listed; the file's coverage counts them
Packages from a private Hex organisation or a self-hosted repository are inventoried but have no vulnerability source
mix.lock does not say which packages are only for :dev or :test, so all are reported
